pages.name: Indian: 2.c3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a route (d4-c3-e4); overview said 2.c3 prepares d5 or b4. Rewrote overview and plan 1 (reviewer rejection: c3 and d4 do not guard e4; fixed and re-reviewed); British spelling.

pages.name: London System Indian Setup with 2. Bf4 e6
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 1 wrote the pawn triangle as a route and suggested h4-h5. Rewrote overview and plan 1 (reviewer rejection of the 'problem bishop' wording fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: London System Main Line with ...d5
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 1 wrote the triangle and the knight route as moves. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: London System Main Line with 3. ...e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported a knight on e5 with f4, where White's bishop stands; plan 2 read c8 as a move; overview dated ...e6 to move 3. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: London System Main Line with Black ...e6 and ...c5
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a rook lift via e3, White's own pawn, and wrote castling as 0-0; overview called the f4-bishop light-squared. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: London System Main Line with Black ...e6 and ...c5
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a b1-knight that is already on d2 via f1, where the bishop stands; plan 3 suggested ...b5 and ...a5. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky 2...g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 relied on ...gxf6 and an open g-file, impossible with the pawn on g6. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky 2...g6 3.Bxf6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 3 offered a ...gxf6 recapture the g6-pawn cannot make. Rewrote overview and plans 2-3 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Trompowsky 2...g6 3.Bxf6 exf6 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Re8 before castling. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky Attack
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 described a pin the e7-pawn blocks; plan 3 played ...g5 onto White's bishop. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling.
